segments.name: Residential Solar Installation
segments.description: Performs solar system, storage and battery installations for residential homeowners in the markets the company serves.
segments.evidence: This segment performs solar system, storage and battery installations for residential homeowners.

segments.name: New Homes Business
segments.description: Performs solar system installations for new home builders, with limited lease arrangements recognized upon system acceptance.
segments.evidence: This segment performs solar system installations for new home builders.

segments.name: Dealer
segments.description: Provides a third-party solar energy sales force that initiates and executes customer contracts sold to installation companies.
segments.evidence: This segment provides a third-party solar energy sales force to initiate and execute contracts with customers throughout the United States.

revenueModel.text: Homeowners and leasing partners pay the company for residential solar installations, and home builders pay for new home systems.
revenueModel.evidence: Homeowners are the customers in cash and financing arrangements, while leasing partners are the customers in power purchase and lease arrangements.

changes.text: The New Homes Business segment was new in 2024 after the acquisition of the SunPower Businesses.
changes.evidence: This segment was new in fiscal year 2024 as a result of the acquisition of the SunPower Businesses in the fourth quarter of fiscal year 2024.

changes.text: The Dealer segment was added in 2025 through the acquisition of Sunder.
changes.evidence: Dealer revenues are attributable to the acquisition of Sunder.

changes.text: In 2023 the company sold the solar panel assets of The Solaria Corporation.
changes.evidence: In October 2023, we sold the solar panel assets of The Solaria Corporation, including intellectual property and customer contracts to Maxeon Solar Technologies, Ltd.
